about: Why a lane opens on the model it does. Each token is one kind of job; scripts/open_terminal.py derives a lane's model from the token its task sheet names, and refuses any other. This file is the project's own (seeded by the Starter Kit, not kit-owned): a new, changed or removed row is the owner's ruling, never an edit made on the way to something else. model is sonnet or opus (Haiku is never opened); reads_source true means a sheet with that reason must list a source document under reads:, not only files under kb/. prescribed (sonnet) and design-latitude (opus, the catch-all for every job no other row fits) are required. Print the table: <venv python> scripts/open_terminal.py --reasons (.venv/Scripts/python.exe on Windows, .venv/bin/python elsewhere)

transcribing.job: figures and dates copied from one source document into a record, word for word, verified by script

filing.job: routing documents the owner has already ruled on -- move, record the manifest row, nothing judged

digesting.job: one document read in full into its kb digest: what it says, with page cites, and what it changes

research.job: one question answered from primary sources, each with its URL and a retrieved: date

drafting.job: one letter or document drafted for the owner to review; it serves nothing

checking.job: the closing check of other lanes' work against the sources, before anything reaches the owner

prescribed.job: build work where the task sheet names the change and a script verifies it

design-latitude.job: build work where the lane chooses how -- INCLUDING every job no other reason here fits
